competitors.name: Move With Manoj Jackson
competitors.offering: Adult dance classes in Coimbatore; Instagram posts mention regular adult classes and dance styles aimed at beginners/intermediate dancers, with Bollywood/hip-hop style positioning in search results.
competitors.schedule: Adults Batch: Monday, Wednesday, Friday; one search snippet shows 6:00 PM–7:30 PM and another shows 8:00 AM–9:00 AM, while the post itself highlights evening availability and classes after work/on weekends.
competitors.fit_reason: This directly competes for working professionals aged 22 to 40 who want affordable adult dance classes in Coimbatore after office hours.
